text_block_list.text:
Seeing how exhausted Tokai Teio was,
I decided to have her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Geez, and here I'm not even tired at all.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer won't stop nagging me,
so I guess I'll take a short break just for you...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Where am I...?

Wah! Look, look, that girl...
It's Tokai Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Where!? Who!?
Ufufu, so cute~!

That's not all!
She's incredibly fast, you know!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geh, there's so many of 'em?!
Where are you guys hiding?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Ah, could you guys be...!

text_block_list.name: Sora
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu... Indeed...!
I am the universe itself watching over you...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
Is that true!?

text_block_list.name: Plants and Trees
text_block_list.text:
Of course it is! You are a treasure... No!
You are brilliance itself!

text_block_list.name: Earth
text_block_list.text:
That was amazing, Teio!
You're the best, Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wah! To be praised by all of creation!
I really am amazing, aren't I!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm getting an itch to run!
Everyone! Watch me go!

text_block_list.name: All Creation
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaaaah—...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, this is so much fun~~!

Running on and on across the vast grasslands,
eventually wrapped in light, and then――

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...
Huh... Where am I...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
My body feels so light!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yay~!
Off to training I go!
Feeling refreshed, Tokai Teio hopped up energetically and left the nurse's office.

—However!
Suddenly, lightning struck right there—
Symboli Rudolf has appeared...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: However... you still cannot reach me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Prez...?

Suddenly, her vision was engulfed in pitch black,
and Tokai Teio was seized
by the sensation of plummeting headfirst.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaahhh---!!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*...
H-Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like...
I had a really scary dream...
Having suffered through nightmares, Tokai Teio was seemingly unable to get a proper rest.
